_comment: If the panel loads but the socket errors immediately with an empty error,
the question is whether `network.domains` is the cause. Swap this file in
as manifest.json, reload the plugin in UDT, and try again.
It connects  -> the domain entries were the problem. Put the real
manifest back and fix the entry rather than shipping
'all', which grants the plugin the whole internet.
It still fails -> the domains were never the problem. Look at the
subprotocol, the origin (the panel's preflight line
says what the relay saw), or the address itself.
`domains: "all"` is a STRING, not an array. That is the documented form
and passing ["all"] does not do the same thing.
name: PSD Reader Sync (all domains)
